note: Adapted from Snyder's (1932) original description of the new species (in English), published as Kalotermes (Neotermes) brevinotus, n. sp. and later transferred to Neotermes; both the (dealate) alate and the soldier are described, each with its own measurements. The alate antennae are broken, the original recording 'Antennae broken, 12 segments'.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Dealate alate with head pale chestnut-brown, slightly longer than wide and covered with many long hairs; compound eyes black, large and projecting, about half an eye diameter from the lower margin of the head; ocelli projecting, large, not circular and transparent, very close to the compound eyes; pronotum slightly wider than the head, anterior margin concave and posterior margin slightly concave; wing scales slightly longer than the pronotum. Soldier with the pronotum very short, nearly 3 times as wide as long; head widest at the compound eyes, the middle of the postmentum very narrow, about one third of the anterior width. The original notes that the large compound eyes, the long hairs and the short soldier pronotum are the diagnostic characters of the species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealate alate: head pale chestnut-brown, slightly longer than wide and covered with many long hairs. Compound eyes black, large and projecting, about half an eye diameter from the lower margin of the head; ocelli projecting, large, not circular and transparent, very close to the compound eyes. Antennae broken, 12 segments remaining, the segments bead-like and of little difference in size. Pronotum concolorous with the head, slightly wider than the head, anterior margin concave and posterior margin slightly concave, with long hairs. Wing scales slightly longer than the pronotum. Basal abdominal tergites with long hairs. Tarsal claws with an arolium. Measurements: total length (dealate) 10.0 mm, head length 2.1 mm, pronotum length 1.2 mm, fore wing scale length 1.45 mm, hind tibia length 1.6 mm; compound eye (long diameter) 0.6 mm; head width (including the compound eyes) 1.9 mm, pronotum width 2.1 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head pale yellowish brown with a darker reddish tinge in front, arched and sloping anteriorly, the epicranial suture slightly visible, covered with rather many long hairs. Eye spot small, indistinct and transparent. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 slightly club-shaped but not distinctly modified and slightly longer than segment 2 or 4; all segments with long hairs. Mandibles black with a reddish base, set in from the sides of the head, slender, pointed and incurved at the tip. Left mandible with 2 short pointed marginal teeth near the apical third and 2 blunt teeth or a molar area at the base; right mandible with a molar area crossing the mandibular margin obliquely in the middle and another molar area parallel to the margin at the base. Middle of the postmentum very narrow, about one third of the anterior width. Pronotum pale yellow, very short and nearly 3 times as wide as long, concave, the posterior margin broadly rounded and shallowly concave, with long hairs. Basal abdominal tergites with long hairs. Hind femur not swollen, the base of the tibia with 3 spines. Measurements: total length 8.0 mm, head including mandibles 3.5 mm, head length to the anterior margin 2.2 mm, left mandible length 1.3 mm, pronotum length 0.5 mm, hind tibia length 0.8 mm; head width at the anterior margin 1.4 mm, greatest width at the middle 1.7 mm, width at the posterior margin 1.5 mm; pronotum width 1.4 mm; head height (at the middle) 1.3 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Sandalo, Costa Rica; described from 1 soldier and 2 dealate alates (collected with nymphs), 1930-04-28, collected by C. W. Dodge. Soldier holotype, Cat. No. 44099 U. S. N. M., the morphotype a dealate alate.
